description: Back in 2004, I wasn’t paying attention to traffic as I was crossing the street, and I got hit by a truck. That experience taught me about the deep anxieties people face when they know they’re one stroke of bad luck away from disaster.I don’t remember much about the accident. I remember the truck was white. I remember trying to get up and people yelling at me to get down. title: America’s healthcare system keeps us one accident away from devastation
